942650.rationale: June 16-17 FOMC (Warsh's first as chair) held 3.50-3.75% by 12-0 and dropped the easing bias. The dot plot moved hawkish: 9 of 18 participants see a 2026 hike. Markets priced about 40% for a July hike on June 19 and Polymarket about 26% on June 22. Hammack, Kashkari and Logan dissented together in April, so the likeliest hike voters are that hawkish trio dissenting at a hold, or all 12 voters if the Fed hikes.
942650.next_info: May PCE (Jun 26), June jobs (Jul 2), June CPI (Jul 14), Fed speeches before the Jul 18 blackout, oil prices and the Iran deal; FOMC decision Jul 29.

408396.rationale: Missouri v. Commerce (E.D. Mo., filed Jan 30 2026) asks to exclude undocumented people and temporary-visa holders, which leaves citizens plus LPRs. This GOP template mirrors the earlier Louisiana suit, so a 2030 residence-criteria proposal would likely require green-card (LPR) status. The alternative is the 2020-memo approach, which excluded only people without lawful status.
408396.next_info: Census Bureau proposed 2030 residence criteria in the Federal Register (expected 2026), any Commerce/Trump announcement, and Missouri case rulings; deadline Sep 30 2026.

76365.rationale: The 3rd Cir. ruled for Kalshi on Apr 6 2026. The 9th Cir. (Nevada) was argued Apr 16 before a panel hostile to Kalshi and is still pending. The 4th Cir. (Maryland) was argued May 7 before a skeptical panel. The 6th Cir. (Ohio and Tennessee, consolidated) is set for argument Jul 30 after its motions panel let Ohio enforce. The 4th and 9th may rule before Aug 31 and then not count, which favors the 6th as the first pro-state ruling after Aug 31.
76365.next_info: Watch for 9th Cir. and 4th Cir. opinions (any day), the 6th Cir. argument on Jul 30, and the Massachusetts SJC; the window is rulings from Sep 1 2026.

154739.rationale: No state-TikTok settlement reported as of Jun 24. TikTok paid a Kentucky school district $8M in May 2026, Nevada's trial is set for Nov 2027, Minnesota survived dismissal, and Florida sued on Jun 15. The pick is low-confidence: Texas (Paxton often settles) and early filers such as Utah, Arkansas and Indiana.
154739.next_info: State trial dates, AG press releases, and TikTok USDS JV (new owners) settling legacy suits; deadline Sep 30.

133827.rationale: Florida filed the first state lawsuit against OpenAI and Altman on Jun 1 2026 (Highlands County) and seeks injunctive relief. A September motion for a temporary injunction halting ChatGPT development fits that case.
133827.next_info: Filings in Florida v. OpenAI and any new AG suits (Texas, Utah) during Sep 2026.

803035.rationale: New York's legislature passed a one-year moratorium on 20MW+ data centers (S10642/A11560) on Jun 4. Hochul has until late December to act and is noncommittal. Maine's moratorium was vetoed Apr 24, and bills in about 12 other states are only introduced.
803035.next_info: Hochul sign or veto (possibly with chapter amendments, often in Dec); any governor EO; special sessions.

903529.rationale: No US measles death reported in 2026 as of June. Cases were 2,073 by mid-June. Counts by state: SC 669 (outbreak over), Utah 486 (slowing, 54 hospitalized, some with encephalitis), Texas 182, Florida 154. The pick weights states by outbreak size.
903529.next_info: CDC Wednesday updates, state health department releases, and any new outbreaks (World Cup importations).

633052.rationale: No 2026 cyclospora news found. Historically Texas has the most CDC-reported domestic cases each summer, with NY and FL next.
633052.next_info: CDC cyclosporiasis page updates (usually start Jun-Jul) and Texas DSHS counts.

481741.rationale: AP analysis of Deportation Data Project data shows ICE arrests peaked at nearly 40k in Dec 2025, with Jan 2026 nearly as high. Arrests then fell after the Minneapolis killings: Feb was down 11-12% and April ran under 1,000 book-ins a day. A summer surge from the bigger ICE workforce is the main risk.
481741.next_info: Next Deportation Data Project/AP data release (likely Jul-Aug) and ICE detention stats.

687277.rationale: Financial activities lost 22k in May 2026, the largest loss of any sector, and is down 107k from a year ago, a persistent trend. Other sectors are only small negatives. Federal government changes are now small.
687277.next_info: June jobs report (Jul 2) and July jobs report (Aug 7).

263626.rationale: April 2026 bilateral deficits were Taiwan $19.3B, Vietnam $19.3B, Mexico $14.8B and China $12.0B. Taiwan is listed first and was the largest in March. AI-server imports keep Taiwan high, but it is close to a coin flip with Vietnam.

605397.rationale: Section 338 has never been used. Greer (Jun 17) said it is an option for 'discrete circumstances' but no panacea. The IEEPA tariffs fell on Feb 20 and the Section 122 10% tariff expires Jul 24. Likely targets are countries seen as discriminating against US goods: Canadian provincial US-alcohol bans, Brazil, China, and countries with digital services taxes.
605397.next_info: Section 122 expiry Jul 24, Section 301 outcomes, USMCA review, Trump statements.

329053.rationale: As of Jun 17-23, Nvidia was about $5.1T against Alphabet about $4.5T and Apple about $4.35T. A gap of roughly 13% is unlikely to close by Jul 17.
329053.next_info: Daily market caps and mid-July earnings (TSMC, etc.).

279946.rationale: SK Hynix plans a Nasdaq ADR offering of up to 45.45T won (about $29.4B, above Alibaba's $25B). The registration is expected to be effective Jul 6, with pricing and listing tentatively on Jul 10, the exact question date. Risks: the schedule slips past Jul 10, the deal is downsized below $25B, or it is not deemed an 'IPO'. SpaceX ($75-86B) is a US company.
279946.next_info: SK Hynix F-1 effectiveness (~Jul 6), roadshow, and pricing (~Jul 9-10).
